newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee ends steady at 35.87/88 against dollar.
newsitem.headline: India rupee ends steady at 35.87/88 against dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.870/877 against the dollar on Thursday compared to the opening quote of 35.87/88 in quiet trade, dealers said.
"The highest business was done at 35.880 and the lowest at 35.870," a dealer at a European bank in Bombay said. He said the rupee moved in this narrow band throughout the day.

"The initial demand which took the dollar to the highs of 35.880/885 yesterday petered out as supplies started trickling in," said a bank in a forex commentary. It said neither the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) nor the state-run Calcutta bank showed any inclination to bid higher than 35.870.
Dealers said the RBI was in the market but not active.
Most dealers said the rupee would continue firm against the dollar until the budget, due this month, if not longer.
"Lack of urgency shown in correcting the value of the rupee gives a sign of complacency," said a dealer.
The forward dollar premia rose mildly on the back of rising overnight call rates, dealers said.
The six-month annualised forward premium closed the day at 7.52 percent against the previous close of 7.47 percent.
